from pathlib import Path
import base64,json,subprocess,io
from PIL import Image
p=Path.cwd()
a=json.loads((p/'inspect_visuals.output.txt').read_text())
ims=[]
for x in a:
 im=Image.open(io.BytesIO(base64.b64decode(x)));im.thumbnail((650,900));ims.append(im)
